title: City Views River Cruise (1.5 hours) - Portland, OR
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
We only serve alcoholic drinks for passengers 21 years old and above, IDs will be checked for all passengers. Passengers below 21 years old will be served non-alcoholic drinks only.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step aboard Portland's only tiki boat for a 1.5-hour river cruise blending laid-back island vibes, scenic city views, and playful onboard fun.

Relax and take in downtown landmarks and iconic bridges, sip a drink, and enjoy the breeze as we cruise the Willamette. A lively host keeps the atmosphere fun with games like trivia and cornhole, plus chances to win prizes. 

Whether you're here to unwind, connect with family, meet new friends, or rediscover the city from the water, this cruise is designed to flow with the moment—a perfect mix of relaxation, socializing, and river adventure, all with unforgettable island style.

This event is 2 hours in full with 1.5-hours guaranteed time underway, cruising along the Willamette. The first 30 minutes of the 2-hour event window is for check-in and boarding. Once all passengers are checked in, the boat departs. Please feel free to email directly with questions or to confirm your scheduled departure time.
